newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles half yr results due March 13.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles half yr results due March 13.

text.p: Australia's largest retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Thursday it would release it results for the 26 weeks to January 26 on March 13 rather than in April as previously advised.

"Our practice has been to release in March. At the time of the 1996 annual report, it was proposed to vary the practice in order to allow our external auditors to complete a review of the results. We have now arranged for this review to be completed on an earlier date," the company said.
Coles Myer has said its sales in the half year rose 5.4 percent to A$9.95 billion. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
